competing_explanation: The 30-day window may be outdated, category-specific, or limited to certain conditions such as unopened or original packaging.
hypothesis_statement: The current policy provides a 30-day full-refund return window for standard items.
refutation_criterion: Authoritative current policy evidence shows standard items have a different return window, no full-refund option, or that the 30-day window applies only to non-standard items.
